remarks: MULTIPLE OFFERS - HIGHEST & BEST DUE MONDAY, 9/28 AT 12 NOON. 26 Revere Drive is currently in a multiple-offer situation. Seller is requesting all interested buyers submit their Highest & Best offer by Monday, September 28th at 12:00 Noon. Please include all terms and supporting documentation with your offer and put 26 Revere in the subject. Thank you for the strong interest!BACK ON THE MARKET & READY FOR A NEW OWNER! Welcome to this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath home in a convenient Stamford location. Offering comfortable one-level living, this home features hardwood floors, plenty of natural light and a functional floor plan.  The spacious living room offers plenty of room to relax or entertain, while the kitchen provides ample cabinet space and an easy everyday layout. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the interior.  Enjoy the added benefit of a private deck, perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining or simply relaxing at the end of the day.  Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation and major commuting routes. An excellent opportunity for a first-time buyer, downsizer or investor looking to add a Stamford property to their portfolio.  Previously tenant-occupied and now vacant, the property is available for showings and ready for its next owner. Come take another look!
